headline: Food‑sector XBIO jumped 12.5% on an 8.3σ volume spike, aligning with a disclosed subsidiary disposal.
market_take: Prop stocks led the market with several double‑digit gains, notably EVER (+28.57%) and RABBIT (+11.43%). Food and Cons sectors showed strong activity, highlighted by XBIO's +12.5% move and CNT's 21.0σ volume spike. A handful of securities posted sharp negative gaps, including APCS and QHOP with -100% open gaps.

sector_notes.note: XBIO surged +12.5% on an 8.3σ volume spike and disclosed a subsidiary disposal; COCOCO also posted a 4.5σ volume spike and a +5.17% price rise.
Multiple prop tickers rallied double‑digits (EVER +28.57%, RABBIT +11.43%, RML +11.11%) while AKS faced a court‑ordered receivership filing.
CNT recorded a +12.27% rise with a 21.0σ volume spike; TEKA showed a 21.5σ volume spike; SRICHA fell -6.52% intraday.
CCP posted an +11.54% intraday move with a 6.4σ volume spike; PPP opened with a +6.76% gap.
M‑STOR climbed +12.90% and opened with a +7.74% gap; M‑PAT added +6.00%.
SMO released an information memo on IPO fund utilization; PPPM announced a trading suspension and delisting.
